description: Ordered feed-ranking features. The index is the position in feed.served_item.features real[]; all values are in [0, 1]. Loaded by Java (feed module) and Python (soundcheck_lab.schema). Changing the list bumps the version and regenerates parity-cases.json.

features.name: follows_author
features.description: 1 if the user follows the author

features.name: follows_artist
features.description: 1 if the user follows any tagged artist

features.name: genre_similarity
features.description: cosine(user genre vector, post genre vector)

features.name: proximity
features.description: exp(-d / 25), d = km from home location to the gig venue; 0 if unknown

features.name: engagement_quality
features.description: Bayesian-smoothed engagement rate, min-max scaled by the global p99

features.name: social_proof
features.description: 1 - exp(-n / 2), n = followed users who liked/commented

features.name: seen
features.description: 1 if impressed by this user in the last 3 days

features.name: position_prior
features.description: always 0 at serve time; absorbs position bias during training
